violations.description: Preventing contamination by consumers. — --Food on display for self service was not properly protected by food guards, display cases, or similarly effective means. -The roller dog machine does not have a sneeze guard or cover of any type.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Every container of food in the storage compartment of the cold-hold prep table are not labeled. There is a bin of bacon in the walk-in cooler not labeled. Any product prepped and out of its original container should be date marked and labeled.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Ice machine shoot is dirty and should be cleaned. The bolts fastening the shoot to the machine are rusting and should be replaced.

Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food. -Raw chicken in a plastic bag found stored on a bin of caramel

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. -Hand wash sink was blocked by a cart and not easily accessible when inspection began.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room was not provided with sufficient mechanical ventilation. -Women's bathroom did not have a working mechanical ventilation system.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Walk-in cooler floor area under storage rack in need of cleaning.
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Clean, employee dressing area, cleaning equipment storage, living/sleeping quarters separate (1 pt deducted)
Clean/dry location, protected, covered, original containers, labeled (2 pts deducted)
Date marking accomplished, discarded (2 pts deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (2 pts deducted)
Properly designed, located, constructed, operated, maintained, cleaned and chemical test kit provided (2 pts deducted)
